_latlon: Exact station point, 4+ decimals, from the Ambient app or a map pin. Every forecast and calibration keys off these -- do not guess from the town name.
_timezone: IANA name. Timestamps are local to the station, not to the viewer.
_contact_email: NWS rejects requests without a User-Agent carrying a real contact. Yours never leaves your config.
_coverage: NWS forecasts, alerts, the discussion and NEXRAD radar are United States only. Outside the US the station panels and Open-Meteo charts still work; the NWS sections render empty.
